title: Decoding the Extracellular Vesicles-driven Communication in the Microenvironment of Hairy Cell Leukemia to Improve Patient Care Management
official: Decoding the Extracellular Vesicles-driven Communication in the Microenvironment of Hairy Cell Leukemia to Improve Patient Care Management
summary: This is a national multi-centre, experimental, cross-sectional, non-profit study.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria for patients:

* WHO2022-defined diagnosis of Hairy Cell Leukemia.
* Age ≥18 years.
* Signed informed consent.

Inclusion criteria for Healthy Donors:

* Age ≥18 years.
* Volunteers in general good health, free from any disease or serious illness.
* Signed informed consent.

Exclusion criteria

\- None
